title: PromptArchitect Persona
description: Schema for PromptArchitect persona files. Place your .json persona files in the same folder as prompt-builder.html and load them via the 'Load Persona' panel.

meta.description: Descriptive metadata shown in the Load Persona UI.

name.description: Short display name shown in the persona card. e.g. 'Senior C# MVC Developer'

description.description: One or two sentences describing what this persona is best used for.

role.description: The role or job title the AI should adopt. e.g. 'Senior C# ASP.NET Core MVC Web Developer'

experience.description: Experience level prefix. Must be one of the select option values.

traits.description: Comma-separated personality traits. e.g. 'concise, opinionated, pragmatic'

context.description: Maps to Step 2 — Context. All fields optional but recommended.

background.description: Background situation, tech stack, team structure, or domain knowledge the AI should have.

audience.description: Who will read the AI's output.

constraints.description: Hard rules: language, style, libraries to avoid, word limits, etc.

task.description: Maps to Step 3 — Task. Provides default values. Users typically override deliverable/goal per-session.

verb.description: Default action verb. Must match one of the select options.

deliverable.description: Default deliverable description. Usually left blank so users fill it in.

goal.description: Default desired outcome. Usually left blank.

onUnknown.description: What the AI should do when uncertain. Must match one of the radio option values exactly.
enum: Say 'I don't know' clearly rather than guessing
Ask a clarifying question before proceeding
Make a clearly labelled assumption and continue
Provide a best-effort answer with a confidence caveat

extra.description: Additional permissions or restrictions. e.g. 'You may cite official docs. Flag security issues proactively.'

type.description: Output format. Must match one of the select option values exactly.
enum: Use markdown with headers and bullet points
Return valid JSON only, no prose
Use code blocks with explanations below each

length.description: Length/depth preference. Must match one of the select option values exactly.
enum: Be concise — aim for under 150 words
Be exhaustive and comprehensive — length is not a concern

extra.description: Any additional formatting instructions not covered by the type/length selects.
